note: Acceptance tolerances for the calculation library (extraction plan E02). Expected values from calc_oracle.py are exact for the double inputs, so these limits cover only the floating-point error of the code under test.

applies_to: model load result, description and component count
JSON round trip of any double (shortest round-trip text)
replicate population SD of R and of the fraction

legacy_printed_statistics.rule: same text; each printed number may differ by one unit in its last digit

displayed_report_values.rule: within half a unit of the last displayed digit

fixture_design_guards.note: Fitted-model fixtures keep this distance so that floating-point differences cannot change selection or pass/fail. The edge fixtures place values on bounds and tolerance edges on purpose.
